Where We Serve

Investigations across South Carolina.

Stillinger Investigations serves clients throughout South Carolina, with a practical focus on Columbia, Lexington, Charleston, Myrtle Beach, Rock Hill, Greenville, and surrounding communities. The agency is also licensed in North Carolina and Georgia for cases that require investigative support across state lines. SC SLED #1586 · NC #990317 · GA #PDC002591.
